title: Mesh-Free Numerical Approximation of the Biharmonic Equation via Optimized Kolmogorov--Arnold Neural Networks
summary: A mesh-free numerical framework based on \textit{Kolmogorov--Arnold Physics-Informed Neural Networks} (KAN-PINNs) is developed for the approximation of fourth-order elliptic boundary value problems, with specific application to the biharmonic equation governing thin plate deflection. Unlike conventional Multi-Layer Perceptrons relying on fixed nodal activations, learnable univariate functions parameterized via radial basis functions are deployed on network edges, while high-order differentiability is preserved through hyperbolic tangent activation mappings.
